name: Title Paragraph
description: Provides a title paragraph that replaces the regular page title with a title, subtitle and image.
project_description:
Provides a title paragraph that can replace regular page titles with a title, subtitle, and image.

 Note: A dependency of this module is Drutopia core . Drutopia is, among other things, an effort to make it easier to share configuration between sites; currently a way to do that is to put common dependencies in a base module. An alternative way would be to have dozens of modules each with the just the configuration needed— in this case, an image field that goes on paragraphs. If you give this a try and want it without the Drutopia core module, i'm open to start splitting things out into configuration dependency modules that can be used independently.
